facts.title: Dash and Trap Shot
facts.text: Endlag removed from both; dash and Trap Shot simultaneous use and jump mid-dash restored. I Am Nagi distance nerfed.

facts.title: NEL evolutions
facts.text: NEL Nagi and NEL Isagi questlines and NEL wheel introduced. Their reworks were still upcoming in this announcement.

facts.title: Ball trajectory metavision
facts.text: White line showing the estimated ball path introduced for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi.

facts.title: Trap Dance removed
facts.text: NEL Trap Dance removed; Zero Reset Turn cooldown increased to 120s.

facts.title: September Nagi changes
facts.text: NEL Nagi awakening cutscenes hidden from goalkeepers; infinite Trap and use of other skills during Trap removed; Trap Shot power −15%; Juggling Shot power −10%; Zero Reset Turn loses ragdoll and travels less. Reverse 2 Stage and its shot removed. Other awakening shot powers reduced.

facts.title: Chemical reaction roster
facts.text: New NEL Isagi–Kaiser and NEL Nagi–NEL Reo; Hiori–Isagi and Sae–Shidou changed; Bachira–Otoya removed. Follow-up says the intended Sae–Shidou rework was not shipped.

history.title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
history.text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

history.title: Anti-cheat and performance hotfix
history.text: Fixed goalkeeper dive and Nagi Trap Shot teleport-back across modes; optimized loading screen and addressed FPS drops/crashes.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Mini update and private server settings
history.text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

history.title: Mobile controls and fixes
history.text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

history.title: Nagi movement and trap changes
history.text: Dash and Trap Shot endlag removed; simultaneous dash/trap shot and jumping mid-dash restored; I Am Nagi distance nerfed.

history.title: Nagi and NEL Nagi rework
history.text: Base Nagi awakening and NEL Nagi kit reworked, including Skull Trap to Breakdance Shot.

history.title: Nagi and Isagi evolution
history.text: NEL questlines and wheel introduced; Generational rarity removed, with Generational styles moved to World Class at the time.

history.title: Rebalance bug fixes
history.text: Fixed a wide range of ability bugs including full-field Street Sweep, Bloodlust, NEL Isagi–Kaiser chemistry cooldown and awakening interactions.

history.title: Great rebalancing
history.text: Ball Trajectory Metavision for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi. Loki base/passive overhaul; extensive style cooldown and range changes, removals and vaulting.

history.title: NEL Nagi passive removed
history.text: NEL Nagi's passive was announced removed.

history.title: Nagi, Loki and Lavinho balance
history.text: Detailed nerfs and removals for Nagi and McNagi, Loki aerial trap removal, Lavinho balance and flow adjustments.

history.title: Chemical reaction system
history.text: Receiver can request a chemical reaction; a button appears to initiate it.

history.title: NEL Nagi and Singularity
history.text: NEL Nagi World Class at release, with volley and ball-control passives. Singularity flow introduced and other styles adjusted.

history.title: Reo and Nagi update
history.text: Reo style and flow, Nagi shooting ability and flow, Sae–Shidou chemistry and Isagi U20 goal added.

history.title: Shidou and Nagi update
history.text: Shidou style added, Nagi buffs and awakening ability announced.

history.title: Early gameplay patch
history.text: Direct Shot fixed, tackle speed increased and duration reduced; Nagi aerial tackle issue addressed.
